Hi Carmen —

Great to hear Phase 1 is stable in production. Per our call last week, this thread is to align on Phase 2 (additional project teams for the Student Portal) and the credentialing / provisioning plan so your engineers can start next month. Proposed items: 

- Who needs API credentials (team/project names + owner emails)
- Expected daily token/embedding volume per project (approx.)
- Preferred rollout cadence (pilot group -> full enablement)
- Any contractual term changes or billing cadence for the new projects

I've attached a short map (EduStream_Phase2_Onboarding_MAP.xlsx) that lists suggested project buckets and a tentative schedule. Can you confirm the project list and whether Procurement needs a separate SOW or addendum? If yes, I'll loop in Marissa on the SOW and Aditya on pricing approval.

Proposed 30-min sync on Thursday (2027-09-16) at 10am PT — does that work?

Thanks,

Hi Jonas —

Thanks, this looks good. Confirming the teams that will need keys for Phase 2:

1) Portal UI (team lead: Lee Armstrong — lee@northfield.edu)
2) Analytics pipeline (team lead: vishal@edustream.io)
3) Notifications service (team lead: sue@edustream.io)

Thursday 10am PT works for me. I'll invite Procurement and Lee.

Hi Carmen —

Thanks for the list — helpful. Procurement-friendly approach: we'll deliver an addendum (Pricing_Tier_Addendum.pdf) as an appendix to the current SOW and include a project-by-project credential table so your security team can see owner/contact for each key. Draft SOW addendum attached for review; this is a working draft.

A couple of notes: 
- Billing mechanics: new projects will be added under the existing account and billed on the current cadence (monthly). If you want them isolated for chargeback, we can issue separate API keys and tagging for per-project breakdowns in the Console.
- Term: we can keep the original master term intact and apply the same renewal date for the added projects — unless you want them to follow a staggered renewal.

I attached a draft SOW and added a proposed credential matrix. Please flag anything Procurement wants changed before our sync.

Marissa / Jonas —

Quick procurement check from our side: can you confirm the following before we sign the addendum?

1) Will the added projects change the effective renewal date or contract value that impacts our budget line this fiscal year?
2) Do you support invoice-level breakdowns by project tag for internal chargebacks?
3) Are there any data residency changes (all traffic remains in us-west)?

If you can confirm in writing, procurement will prepare the internal approval and we can route sign-off through DocuSign.

Hi Marta / Procurement team —

Answers inline: 

1) Renewal/date: Adding the projects will not change the master renewal date. The addendum will be effective immediately and will roll into your existing renewal window. We can, however, create staggered billing if you need a different financial treatment — please confirm which projects if so.

2) Invoice breakdown: Yes. We can provide per-project tag breakdowns on the invoice and via the Console export. We'll include tags in the credential matrix so your finance team has a canonical mapping.

3) Residency: No changes — all serving will remain in us-west region. If you later require EU residency for specific projects, we can scope that as a separate item.

Also confirming the pilot start: we are ready to provision the first three API keys for the pilot once procurement signs the addendum. DocuSign link will be sent after your internal approval.

Jonas
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
